profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LG Electronics
profile.summary: Front-end Unity® developer of 7 years for mobile, PC, AR and VR platforms.  Helped create applications and social platforms from the ground up with remote teams all over the world.  Focused on creating solutions for new technologies and is always pushing what the Unity® engine can do.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Team Lead for Emerging Techology Department 3D asset team, leading planning and execution for backend, frontend and applications for Simulation, Metaverse, LG Product Asset Platform and related applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Team Lead for LG SVL Simulator core team
- Responsible for Unity® core simulation features from spec to release
- Manage team tasking and planning
- Implemented Unity® Editor HD map annotation tool
- Support Simulator software on Windows and Linux via GitHub issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented traffic/pedestrian behavior logic, control systems, FMU dynamics models, UI and UX
- Created Unity® Editor tools for users
- Migrated old Simulator code base to Unity® HDRP

positions.title: Senior Unity Developer
positions.description:
- Unity C#
SofaSocial
- Created pipeline for artists to create AR content.
- Created an application that simulates AR for artists and exports asset bundles for back-end.
TimeWalk
- Optimized VR application from 15 fps to 90+fps.
- Removed legacy code and assets.
- Integrated web views inside VR with web controls.
- Created multi scene navigation with first person and VR control types.
- Developed framework for the TimeWalk platform.
- Developed and presented class materials and demo for Unity® introduction classes

positions.title: Senior Unity Developer
positions.description:
(previously SofaVR)
- Unity C#
- Developed AR application where users could interact with popular VR titles IP's.
- Worked with assets from the creators of Raw Data, Quivr, Unspoken, Beast Pets, Snow Fortress, Drunkn’ Bar Fight and in house content.
- Leased application and hardware to AR arcades, e.g., IMAX VR in L.A., VR Junkies in Utah and Exit Reality in San Francisco.  VR arcades had access to our social platform that stored all videos from our app and could display popular videos on-site from unique URLs.
- Integrated ARKit and proprietary sensor code for devices that lacked ARKit support.
- Developed ways to handle low light AR experiences in dark VR arcades.
- Developed UX for experienced and inexperienced mobile users so all ages could enjoy the application.
- Developed direct manipulation of the render pipeline in Unity to preview frames recorded, place watermarks or logos directly from server side networks and stylized vignettes, all recorded and uploaded to the Sofa Social platform.
- Developed content pipeline for artists to create asset bundles and the application framework for installing content during run-time.
- Developed client-side code for Sofa API and the Sofa Social platform.
- Collaborated and managed engineers, artists, third-party developers and repositories.
- Integrated Sofa API with Snow Fortress, Drunkn’ Bar Fight and Ruckus Ridge.
- Developed mobile, AR, VR and PC platform applications and third-party integration.
- Prototyped game mechanics and frameworks for AR, VR and mobile with VR.

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
- Unity C#
- Collaborated and managed engineers, artists, third-party developers and repositories.

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
- Managed multiple mobile platform applications and third party integrations.
- Created application framework for use in Unity.
- Collaborated with engineers, artists and third party developers.
- Developed Unity application client side code for in house API.
- Created game play for multiplayer endless runner.
- Unity C#

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- Created new game play mechanics on a multiplayer endless runner mobile game.
- Expanded UI/UX to enhance the user experience.
- Managed 3rd party development team, tasking and working together to create new game play.
- Unity C# front end programming and repository management.
- Prototype new game mechanics and frameworks.
- Design pattern prototyping.
- 3D and 2D asset creation.

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
- Unity C# front end programming on multiple mobile games.
- Tasking and implementing 3rd party developer assets.
- Prototype frameworks and design patterns.
- Implementation of Oculus Rift in Unity.
- On board artists and programmers as an assistant producer role.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
- C# front end programming
- Mobile game QA

educations.degreeName: Associate of Applied Science in Visual Communications
educations.fieldOfStudy: 3D Modeling & Animation, Web Design, Digital Video, Broadcast Graphics,  Interactive Communication D
